mapper.sql: select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope,ia.industry_code, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark,r.role_type,t.tenant_name,r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.update_by, r.update_time, a.AREA_NAME AS province_name,b.AREA_NAME AS city_name, r.tenant_id,ia.app_ver_code from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role_industry_auth rt on rt.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel dr on dr.role_id=r.ROLE_ID inner join sys_industry_auth ia on ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id left join sys_tenant_info t on t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON a.area_code = t.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area b ON b.area_code = t.city_id

otherwise.if: AND ( r.tenant_id like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{role.tenantSearch}),'%') or t.tenant_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{role.tenantSearch}),'%') )

mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope, ia.industry_code, r.STATUS, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, t.tenant_name, r.create_by, r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.tenant_id, ia.app_ver_code FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth rt ON rt.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel dr ON dr.role_id = r.ROLE_ID inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
mapper.select:
select r.* from sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ria ON r.ROLE_ID = ria.role_id inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = ria.auth_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.tenant_id = #{role.tenantId} and r.role_type='2'
AND r.status = #{role.status}
AND r.role_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{role.roleName}),'%')
and ia.industry_code = #{role.industryCode} and ia.app_ver_code = #{role.appVerCode} union
SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ria ON r.ROLE_ID = ria.role_id inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = ria.auth_id WHERE ia.industry_code = #{role.industryCode} and ia.app_ver_code = #{role.appVerCode} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.ROLE_TYPE='1'
AND status = #{role.status}
AND role_name like CONCAT('%',#{role.roleName},'%')

select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, srdr.data_scope, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark,r.role_type,r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.tenant_id from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel srdr ON srdr.role_id = r.ROLE_ID where 1=1
and r.tenant_id is not null and r.role_key like CONCAT(#{key},'%')
and r.role_type=#{roleType} and r.role_key like CONCAT(#{key},'%')
order by r.role_id desc limit 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ria ON ria.role_id = r.ROLE_ID inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = ria.auth_id WHERE ia.industry_code=#{industryCode} AND r.ROLE_TYPE='1' AND r.DEL_FLAG='0'
AND r.role_name like CONCAT('%',#{roleName},'%')
AND r.role_key like CONCAT('%',#{roleKey},'%')
AND r.status = #{status}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.STATUS, r.del_flag, r.role_type FROM sys_role r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.role_type in ('0','1') and r.status = '0'

select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, srdr.data_scope, r.tenant_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL from sys_role r, sys_role_industry_auth rt,sys_industry_auth ia,sys_role_data_rel srdr where r.role_id = rt.role_id and ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id and r.role_type = '2' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_id = srdr.role_id and
(ia.industry_code = #{item.industryCode} and ia.app_ver_code = #{item.appVerCode})
union
select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, srdr.data_scope, r.tenant_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL from sys_role r left join sys_role_data_rel srdr on srdr.role_id = r.role_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.role_type = '1' and r.status = '0'

select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.tenant_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL from sys_role r, sys_role_industry_auth rt,sys_industry_auth ia where r.role_id = rt.role_id and ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id and r.role_type = '2' and r.del_flag = '0'
(ia.industry_code = #{item.industryCode} and ia.app_ver_code = #{item.appVerCode})

SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, tmp.industry_code, r.STATUS, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by, r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.tenant_id, tmp.app_ver_code FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT rt.role_id, ia.industry_code, ia.app_ver_code FROM sys_role_industry_auth rt INNER JOIN ( SELECT ia.auth_id, ia.industry_code, ia.app_ver_code FROM sys_industry_auth ia WHERE ia.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND ia.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} ) ia ON ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id ) tmp ON r.role_id = tmp.role_id WHERE r.del_flag = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId}
order by r.role_sort

select DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.tenant_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL,srdr.data_scope,ur.user_id from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel srdr ON srdr.role_id = ur.role_id where 1 = 1
AND
ur.user_id = #{item.userId} and srdr.industry_code=#{item.industryCode} and srdr.app_ver_code=#{item.appVerCode}
and ( r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id or r.role_type = '1')

select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope,dr.industry_code, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark,r.role_type,r.create_by,r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.tenant_id,dr.app_ver_code from sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth rt ON rt.role_id = r.role_id inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel dr ON dr.role_id = r.ROLE_ID where r.role_id = #{role.roleId} and dr.industry_code=#{role.industryCode} and dr.app_ver_code=#{role.appVerCode}
where r.role_key = #{roleKey}

SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope, tmp.industry_code, r.STATUS, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, t.tenant_name, r.create_by, r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.update_by, r.update_time, a.AREA_NAME AS province_name, b.AREA_NAME AS city_name, r.tenant_id, tmp.app_ver_code FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_rel dr ON dr.role_id = r.ROLE_ID inner JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT rt.role_id, ia.industry_code, ia.app_ver_code FROM sys_role_industry_auth rt INNER JOIN ( SELECT ia.auth_id, ia.industry_code, ia.app_ver_code FROM sys_industry_auth ia WHERE ia.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND ia.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} ) ia ON ia.auth_id = rt.auth_id ) tmp ON r.role_id = tmp.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON a.area_code = t.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area b ON b.area_code = t.city_id WHERE r.del_flag = '0' and u.user_name = #{userName} order by r.role_sort
select * from sys_role r where r.role_key=#{roleKey}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role( role_name, role_key, role_sort, status, remark, create_by, tenant_id, role_type, ROLE_LEVEL, create_time )values( #{roleName}, #{roleKey}, #{roleSort}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{tenantId}, #{roleType}, #{roleLevel}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete:
update sys_role set del_flag = '2' where role_id in
#{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS user_id, DEPT_ID AS staff_org_id, NICK_NAME as keeper_name, SEX as keeper_gender, PHONENUMBER as keeper_phone_number, EMAIL as keeper_email FROM sys_user WHERE USER_NAME = #{loginName} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

select * from sys_role where role_id in
#{item}
